visual.name: advanVisFlareScope
visual.description: A live flare stack for Power BI. The flame grows with the flare gas flow and alarm bands (low-low, low, normal, high, high-high) run up the stack, from fixed values or from your own threshold fields. Five structures (derrick, self-supported, guyed, offshore boom, enclosed ground flare) on night, dusk, day or clear scenes. Status, value and change at a glance; a trend with the bands, threshold lines and flaring events, with replay of the whole period; events with duration, peak and volume, totals and CO2e; rate of change and time to high-high at the current rate; pilots lit or out; wind that leans the flame; smoke above the smokeless capacity; estimated ground heat zones; several flares side by side for a whole site; stale data warning; tooltips, cross-filtering, keyboard, screen readers, reduced motion and high contrast. A licence is required (one-month free trial through Microsoft AppSource).
